'''Mola Haxtor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as one of the three [[Rakghoul]] experts on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] at the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]<ref name="Missing Link" /> and during the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Invasion of Taris]]. A [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologist]]<ref name="Missing Link" />, she and her partner, fellow professor [[Sadus Vraal]], discovered the [[nekghoul]]s, [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-using [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[rakghoul]]s.<ref name="WDA">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Where Darkness Abides|Taris}}</ref> However, after only a short time for research, she was captured by Imperial forces, and was [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] for information on this new breed of rakghoul.
